run_compare_binaries: run compare_binaries to compare observations from multiple StarCraft II game binaries against a replay file
test_compare_binaries: test compare_binaries with --diff flag to detect non-deterministic differences between two SC2 binary versions
review_main: review the main function that launches multiple SC2 game controllers and steps through replay observations
summarize_clear_non_deterministic: summarize _clear_non_deterministic_fields which strips non-deterministic fields like unit tags from observations for comparison
refactor_compare_binaries: refactor compare_binaries to support comparing observations across multiple remote SC2 API server connections
